description: Repairs r-sql-13b/like-null-pattern-edges and r-sql-13b/like-operand-types: pattern-like rows and an all-Null row spoiled two queries. Asks what LIKE does with a pattern taken from the row, over LKC (no wildcard or bracket characters; case and accent variants, padded, empty and Null text): t LIKE t, t LIKE Left(t, 1) & '*' and their projected truth values; and CStr(dt) LIKE and Format(dt, 'yyyy') LIKE over BT with its Null row excluded by a derived table, the unfiltered form as control. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE LKC (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_LKC PRIMARY KEY, t TEXT(20))
INSERT INTO LKC (id, t) VALUES (9, ' abc')
SELECT id FROM LKC WHERE t LIKE t ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM LKC WHERE t LIKE Left(t, 1) & '*' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, (t LIKE t) AS m1, (t LIKE Left(t, 1) & '*') AS m2 FROM LKC ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE BT (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_BT PRIMARY KEY, dt DATETIME)
INSERT INTO BT (id, dt) VALUES (4, Null)
SELECT id FROM BT WHERE CStr(dt) LIKE '*2024*' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM (SELECT id, dt FROM BT WHERE dt Is Not Null) WHERE CStr(dt) LIKE '*2024*' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM (SELECT id, dt FROM BT WHERE dt Is Not Null) WHERE Format(dt, 'yyyy') LIKE '2024' ORDER BY id
